'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 University of Idaho killings]]
**In [[Pennsylvania]], [[United States]], the alleged perpetrator of a mass stabbing of four [[University of Idaho]] students, 28-year-old Bryan Christopher Kohberger, is arrested by police in the [[Pocono Mountains]]. *A judge in [[Bolivia]] orders opposition figure [[Luis Fernando Camacho]] to be remanded in detention for four months on "[[terrorism in Bolivia|terrorism]] [[criminal charge|charges]]", as opposition parties call for a national [[strike action|strike]].
